title: [Pre Order, Switch 2] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time $95 ($85 after $10 Newsletter Sign-up Voucher) Delivered @ Target
body:
Deal: [Pre Order, Switch 2] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time $95 ($85 after $10 Newsletter Sign-up Voucher) Delivered @ Target

[shiny1] Does anyone know if putting the cartridge into the console will ask it to update or force an installation, or can I play the game without internet/updates?
[pingMarky] Not out yet..we can only assume you'll be ok
[conza] This is the right question, it's clearly not a game key card, but hopefully it fits onto 64GB. If there are minor patches later, that's fine, but if it is unplayable without a patch then it's not worth purchasing for a lot of people.
[sunyuanxin] Most games need updates, so how are you supposed to do that without internet? You can just use your phone as a hotspot.
[UrbionPT] You not getting the point. It’s not about internet access now, it’s in 15/20 years time.
[Tyrx] 95% of people looking to prevent updates are not interested in preservation. They are concerned that an update may patch a vulnerability that allows themselves to jailbreak the Switch 2, which will allow for piracy.
[Valowick] https://www.doesitplay.org/
This is an issue people actually care about.
[Dollar Dreamer] My brother failed his HSC due to this game. He is a warehouse forklift bum now. He wanted to do Business Information Systems at Sydney Uni. He still blames this game for stuffing his life up. I was smart, I finished my degree first and then played this game, twice.
[corgi-runner] Never too late for him to change course.
[lmpoikjeu] At least he failed because of a good game. My brother failed his HSC because he was too obsessed with Garfield Kart: Furious Racing.
[Nom] I.T. is one field that you don't need a degree for - just start on the Helpdesk at large University or similar, and once you've been there for a year and created some connections, you can apply and move into a team that you actually want to work in.
The Helpdesk roles come up frequently because of the above !
Once you've got some experience, your I.T. career begins 🤘
[kosh52] Is this with the limited edition lenticular cover case?
[RichardL] All preorders of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time includes special packaging that features textured foil cover art.
We (Australia) only get the textured foil cover art.
EB Games Canada gets a cool holographic N64 slipcover
[j1nx] How do you know that? It says all preorders get the foil, but not that all copies sold in Aus will be foil, as your comment suggests.
The Nintendo store itself says that it is while stocks last:
Pre-purchases placed now are still expected to receive stock from the first print run, with textured foil cover art. This page will be updated when the special packaging is no longer in stock.
[RocketSwitch] But they don't get the textured foil right? I want both.
[RichardL] Try refreshing, was originally showing out of stock for me too.
[King Steuart] Got it, thanks. Now just need the same price for GTA VI
[kosh52] Btw, for those buying this game with the blind hope that nintendoh has added da tryforce or the sage temple your in for some disappointment - it’s not in the game
[mangobango] Was about to buy it, waited a bit, then saw "low stock" and quickly grabbed it. $80.75 delivered with 5% discounted gift cards. Thanks OP!
I can wait a few days for delivery since Final Fantasy Resonance will probs still be keeping me busy
[Onemoredeal] I don’t even know why I pre ordered it I’ll be playing GTA for 3 months or more
[AustriaBargain] You can run both at the same time, twice the hype.
[mangobango] At least you'll have the fancy foil cover version!
[Kerrby] How is this out of stock already?? Did they only get 20 copies? Big W out of stock too.
